detail.title: Integrating Neuro-Symbolic Error Correction into Metareasoning Frameworks
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes progress in project proj-assumption-testing-epistemology by examining how neuro-symbolic rule-based frameworks provide error correction for models operating in novel environments.
